title: New shipping method wired through checkout, storage, warehouse and email
measures: Adds in-store pickup through every place a shipping method reaches: the method table, checkout validation (no delivery address), the quote, the order repository's row mapping, the carrier manifests (nothing for the carrier) and the confirmation email sent by a background job (pickup address instead of a delivery address); each is checked through its public entry point.
prompt: Add in-store pickup as a shipping method ("pickup"). It's free, and the customer collects the order at our shop (address in config/shop.json), so there is no delivery address at checkout and nothing for the carrier.

commits.message: feat(checkout): shipping methods, orders, carrier manifests, confirmation emails
